DRAFT candidate: Audit compression breakout logic for overfitting to synthetic data (task 991ce32e-642e-4d17-97ac-804aef74aaf2)

**Observation**: Stage-1 results show extreme volatility (max drawdown: -4701.52) with a 0.187 WR (below 0.5 threshold). Positive PnL on 2026-05-04 (+804.72) but 2026-04-29 (-23.95) and 2026-05-01 (-21.56) indicate inconsistent edge capture. Winners capture (759.21) matches edge capture, but wide PnL (-1464.23) suggests overfitting to synthetic BS pricing.  

**Root cause**: Strategy likely overfits to synthetic option surfaces (lib.pricing.black_scholes) without real-fill validation (C1: Real-fills is the only WR authority). Breakout logic may misfire during regime shifts (C4: Disclose concentration, normalize OOS).  

**Fix**:  
1. Add C1 guardrail: Reject all synthetic backtests unless real-fill WR ≥ 0.70.  
2. Add C4 guardrail: Normalize OOS by regime (e.g., VIX > 25, SPY volatility > 15%) to avoid overfitting to synthetic BS assumptions.  
3. Add C6 guardrail: Filter all signals to <= current bar (no look-ahead bias).  

**Impact**: Without these, the strategy will fail in live trading due to overfitting to synthetic data (L307: SPY-price edge != option edge).
